frame_sampling: 16 frames uniformly spaced over the decoded video (cv2 grab/retrieve; sequential fallback)
clip_frames: model clips use every 2th cached frame (evaluation averages the 2 offsets; training draws 8 random sorted frames)

crop.rule: square side = max(w,h)*(1+2*margin), clipped inside the frame, 3-frame box smoothing, nearest-detection box for frames without a face, full frame when no face in the video

degraded_crops: degraded videos are cropped with their SOURCE video's relative face boxes (pixel-aligned pairs)

audio.source: external .wav if present, else ffmpeg audio stream; tiled/cropped to 3 s; silent/no audio -> zero spectrogram + mask 0
audio.spectrogram: STFT n_fft 512, hop 256, win 512 Hann, log1p magnitude, bilinear 128x128, per-clip z-score clip +-3 /3

failed_video_handling: originals whose frames cannot be decoded are excluded before grouping (status recorded); degraded videos that fail decoding or the content-link test are excluded
label_independence: no preprocessing function receives a label; real and fake videos share one code path
